query: I just got back from walking my dog this morning, he chased a squirrel all around the park and ended up getting his leash tangled around a park bench, it took me ten whole minutes to get him free. Then on the way home I stopped at the neighborhood bakery and picked up a warm cinnamon roll, it was so flaky and sweet, I ate the whole thing before I even walked in the door. I also just remembered I need to pick up some cat litter on my way out tomorrow, my cat's almost run out and the pet store nearby closes early on weekends. But anyway, I need to cancel two pending orders first: order #W9373487 and order #W5481803, both for the reason that they're no longer needed. I also need to return the item with number 6477915553 from delivered order #W7449508, and please process the refund to my payment method gift_card_7711863.
